units.source_text: 把信系在一根梅花枝上，召使者来，吩咐道：“你走西面的走廊，把这信送去。

en.t: He tied the letter to a branch of plum blossoms, summoned a messenger, and instructed him, "Go along the western corridor and deliver this letter.

units.source_text: ”自己就在窗前坐下，眺望庭中雪景。

en.t: " Then he sat down by the window and gazed out at the snowy garden.

units.source_text: 他身穿白色便服，手中捻弄着多余的梅花枝，观赏略已消融而还在“等待友朋来”的残雪上重又降下新雪来的景色。

en.t: Dressed in plain white robes, he toyed with the extra plum branch in his hand and admired the sight of fresh snow falling again over the lingering snow that had partly melted and seemed still to be "waiting for a friend to come."

units.source_text: 此时有个黄莺，在附近的红梅树梢上啭出清脆的声音。

en.t: Just then a bush warbler, perched in the top of a nearby red plum tree, sang out in a clear voice.

units.source_text: 源氏吟着“折得梅花香满袖”之歌，把梅枝收藏起来，撩起帘子向外眺望。

en.t: Genji murmured the poem about plucking plum blossoms and filling one's sleeves with fragrance, put the branch away, lifted the curtain, and looked outside.

units.source_text: 他那姿态异常年轻而优美，叫人万万想不到这是一个身为父亲而官居高位的人。

en.t: His figure looked so remarkably young and graceful that no one would have imagined he was a father and a man of high office.

units.source_text: 他料想三公主的回信要过一会儿才可送到，便走进内室，把梅枝给紫姬看，对她说道：“既称为花，必须有这种香气才好。

en.t: Thinking that the Third Princess's reply would take some time to arrive, he went into the inner room, showed the plum branch to Lady Murasaki, and said to her, "If something is to be called a flower, it ought to have this kind of fragrance.

units.source_text: 如果能把这种香气移在樱花上，那么其他所有的花全都不在我心上了。

en.t: If this fragrance could be transferred to cherry blossoms, then no other flowers at all would matter to me.

units.source_text: ”又说：“这梅花在我尚未看到其他许多花时最先受我注目。

en.t: " He added, "This plum blossom was the first to catch my eye, before I had seen many other flowers.

units.source_text: 但愿它能和樱花同时并开才好。

en.t: How fine it would be if it could bloom side by side with the cherry blossoms at the same time.

units.source_text: ”正在谈话，三公主的回信送来了。

en.t: " While they were still talking, the Third Princess's reply arrived.
The letter paper was red, and its wrapping was very splendid.

units.source_text: 源氏有些儿狼狈，他想：“三公主笔迹很幼稚，暂时勿让紫姬看见吧。

en.t: Genji felt somewhat flustered and thought, "The Third Princess's handwriting is very childish; for now I had better not let Lady Murasaki see it.

units.source_text: 并非有意疏远她，只因太浅陋了，于公主面子有碍。

en.t: It is not that I mean to keep her at a distance, but the writing is too crude and would damage the princess's dignity.

units.source_text: ”然而又念此时把信隐藏起来，反而使紫姬多心，于是展开信纸一端，让紫姬看见。

en.t: " Yet he then reflected that hiding the letter now would only make Lady Murasaki suspicious, so he unfolded one end of the paper and let her see it.

units.source_text: 紫姬斜倚着身子，用眼梢窥看。

en.t: Lady Murasaki leaned to one side and glanced at it from the corner of her eye.
